summary: Frontend-only testing of TaskMint Expo app (mobile viewport 390x844). All 11 critical flows PASS: Login→Details→Home onboarding, name/mobile validation, Home header (points pill shows 0 pts initially, 50 pts after daily check-in), segmented toggle (Offerwall/Play & Earn), empty-state for Firestore-locked Offerwall (no crash), daily-checkin-button adds +50 points, game-card navigation (higher-lower), game-get-chances adds +5 chances (ads no-op on web as expected), Wallet balance reflects points/1000 (₹0.05 for 50 pts), amount chip selection, method toggle, history tabs, withdraw validation shows error toast on invalid input, Profile long-press on version opens admin-key-modal, wrong key → greet-modal, correct key 'TaskMint000' → Admin Panel, manage-tabs switches between Banners/Offerwalls/Update without crash, admin stat cards render (payouts/offerwall stats show '—' because Firestore is locked, which is EXPECTED). Firestore permission-denied errors seen in console (expected). No red-screen crashes anywhere. Minor non-blocking console warnings only (RN Web deprecations: shadow* style props, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver fallback — these are React Native Web platform warnings, not bugs).

issues: Dashboard stat cards are in a horizontal ScrollView — on 390px viewport only ~2.5 cards are visible at a time; this is intentional horizontal scroll, user can swipe. Not a bug but worth confirming on real device.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple components use shadow* style props which are deprecated on RN Web ('shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'). Only a web preview warning; native Android/iOS still support shadow* properly. Non-blocking.
Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — this is the expected RN Web fallback to JS-based animation, not an issue on native builds.

action_items: No blocker bugs — all requested flows pass. Firestore rules remain locked (expected for this iteration).
Optional polish: migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (cosmetic only).

When Firestore rules are opened in a later iteration, re-test: banner carousel visibility, offerwall tasks list + task detail popup + proof submission, payout+offerwall submission → admin counters increment and admin review screens list items.
critical_code_review_comments: UserContext.spendPoints uses setPoints functional updater + setTimeout(0) tick to read 'ok' — works but fragile; consider using a ref or returning a boolean from a non-React path to avoid race conditions on rapid taps.
game/[id].tsx and admin/index.tsx are well under 700 lines and modular — no DRY violations spotted.
All interactive elements have testID attributes as required.
Firestore errors are correctly swallowed in UserContext.reconcile with empty catch, preventing crashes.
seed_data_creation: None. Onboarded with name='Test User', mobile='9876543210' locally on device.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Firestore rules are locked (permission-denied on all reads). Local-only flows (onboarding, points math, games+chances, daily check-in, wallet UI, admin access gate, admin manage tabs) all verified working. Once Firestore rules open up, re-test: BannerCarousel display, Offerwall task list + task-card-{id} tap + TaskDetailModal + proof submission, admin stat counts, admin/payouts and admin/offerwall-requests review screens. All testIDs used in this run match the spec and work correctly in the web preview.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The permission-denied Firestore errors in console are expected and documented in test_credentials.md; the app handles them gracefully with empty states and error toasts.
